name: Contractbook
description: Contractbook is a contract lifecycle platform for drafting, signing, centralizing, and automating agreements.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated customer-owned Contractbook production API key and let agents list bounded document IDs, types, states, and lifecycle timestamps. Relay fixes Public API v3 to full=false and excludes titles, owners, parties, emails, fields, tags, workspaces, files, sharing, signing, writes, administration, cursors, and key material.

credentialRequirements.name: CONTRACTBOOK_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Contractbook API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated customer-owned production API key in Contractbook profile settings and store the one-time value only through Relay's encrypted connection flow.

capabilities.label: List document lifecycles
capabilities.description: List bounded document IDs, types, states, and lifecycle timestamps without titles, people, fields, files, or cursors.

allowed.label: List document lifecycles
allowed.description: List at most 25 strictly projected document IDs, types, states, and lifecycle timestamps.

blocked.label: Access private document data
blocked.description: Titles, owners, parties, signees, emails, addresses, numbers, messages, data fields, tags, folders, workspaces, permissions, comments, tasks, and document content are blocked.

blocked.label: Access files, sharing, or signing
blocked.description: PDFs, attachments, download links, uploads, collaborators, sharing, signature requests, signing, resending, and webhook payloads are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or administer Contractbook
blocked.description: Draft creation, template use, document updates or deletion, automations, space changes, API-key management, and administration are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw or bulk access
blocked.description: Full responses, raw paths, arbitrary filters, cursors, pagination, polling, retries, batches, exports, and provider-response pass-through are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read-only document lifecycle metadata
approvalProfiles.description: One fixed privacy-redacted production document list runs automatically through a customer-owned API key.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Customer ownership, production binding, fixed route and query, key secrecy, strict projection, result bounds, audits, and no-write behavior remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway confines the customer-owned production API key to health and one fixed strictly projected document-lifecycle read.
Railway confines the customer-owned production API key to health and one fixed strictly projected document-lifecycle read.

providerSetup.blocker: Contractbook API access is plan-gated and API keys authorize the customer's Public API v3 account surface. A production key is shown once when created. No account, plan confirmation, API-key generation, live provider session, Railway change, or production acceptance is available in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized Contractbook user enables API access, creates a dedicated production API key in profile settings, and stores its one-time value through Relay's encrypted connection flow. They then separately validate bounded lifecycle listing, least privilege, rate limits, key rotation and revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Contractbook's official Public API v3 reference documents the production base URL, Bearer API-key authentication, one-time key display, GET /v3/documents, page_size maximum 100, cursor pagination, full=false versus full=true, document fields, and broad write/file/share/signing surfaces that Relay blocks.
Contractbook documents customer creation, naming, storage, management, and permanent revocation of API keys from profile settings, plus separate support-generated SCIM keys.
Contractbook lists API access as a plan add-on for Centralize and Accelerate with fair-usage limits and describes broad contract creation and automation capability.
